test: validateData infers a blank ROUND_DISPERSION from the SD's printed decimals, per variable, and keeps a supplied one
the interval a printed SD stands for: half a unit either side, never below zero, zero stays zero, blanks inferred
a coarsely printed SD changes the null the row is judged against; a finely printed one barely does
a direct caller without ROUND_DISPERSION gets the inference the validator would make
a printed SD of exactly zero is not an interval: identical arms with SD 0 still sit at p = 0.5
the interval never goes below zero, and a coarse claim the SD does not sit on is refused
